definitions: A global war that lasted from 1939 to 1945, though some related conflicts began earlier.
The largest and deadliest war in history, involving the vast majority of the world's countries, including all the great powers, forming two opposing military alliances: the Allies and the Axis.
examples: World War II had a profound impact.
Many veterans of World War II are still remembered.
The end of World War II brought significant changes.
